List = use "std/list".
go : unsafe Int -> Int -> Int.
go r acc = if r == 0 then acc else go (r - 1) (acc + (List.sum (List.range 1 1000000))).
main = print (go 8 0).

Tree = Type (Leaf | Node Tree Int Tree).
build : unsafe Int -> Int -> Tree.
build d k = if d == 0 then Leaf else Node (build (d - 1) (2 * k)) k (build (d - 1) (2 * k + 1)).
total : unsafe Tree -> Int.
total t = case t of Leaf -> 0 | Node l k r -> total l + k + total r.
go : unsafe Int -> Int -> Int.
go r acc = if r == 0 then acc else go (r - 1) (acc + (total (build 18 1))).
main = print (go 8 0).
